purpose: Honest source-tiered country-reference rows for Kenya + Tanzania so the model/sheet do NOT silently fall back to Singapore opex/energy/grid-CO2/crew/marina (golden rule #8). Merge against the LIVE finance/model/country-reference.json schema; values are estimate-tier and must be confirmed by finance before a final cascade.
capex_region_rule: Both Kenya and Tanzania are non-US/non-EU -> $600K/vessel (LB-243).

Kenya.grid_co2_basis: Kenya grid ~90%+ renewable (geothermal/hydro/wind, incl. Lake Turkana); among the cleanest grids in Africa. Strong zero-emission narrative.
Kenya.crew_basis: Coastal Kenya marine crew estimate; well below Singapore. Confirm.
Kenya.marina_basis: English Point Marina (Mombasa) / Kilifi Creek berthing estimate.
Kenya.notes: Clean grid is a marquee ESG selling point for the Kenya coast legs.

Tanzania.grid_co2_basis: Tanzania grid gas-heavy with growing hydro (Julius Nyerere HPP ramping); moderate intensity. Still far cleaner per-trip than diesel ferries it displaces.
Tanzania.crew_basis: Dar/Zanzibar marine crew estimate; well below Singapore. Confirm.
Tanzania.marina_basis: Dar Slipway / Zanzibar ferry-terminal berthing estimate.
Tanzania.notes: Displacing diesel fast-ferries gives a strong per-trip CO2 reduction even at moderate grid intensity; JNHPP hydro ramp improves it over the model horizon.
